authorization.reason: Authorization defects can cross actor and resource boundaries.

multi-tenancy.reason: Tenant isolation failures can expose or corrupt another tenant's data.

payment.reason: Money movement requires independent negative and recovery evidence.

sensitive-data.reason: Sensitive-data changes require independent security review.

data-migration.reason: Migration failures can be irreversible without a rehearsed recovery.

external-side-effect.reason: External side effects require idempotency and recovery evidence.

public-contract.reason: Public contract changes require compatibility and consumer evidence.

breaking-public-api.reason: A breaking public contract requires major-release acceptance.

governance-schema.reason: A governance schema change can invalidate every generated project.

scope-boundary.description: The change scope, exclusions, user-owned files, and migration authorization were independently reviewed.

defect-reproduction.description: The defect was reproduced against the prior version with exact inputs and observable failure.

negative-positive-regression.description: A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it.

affected-scope-verification.description: Tests, type checks, lint, and build for the affected scope passed.

business-contract.description: Actors, resources, owners, states, authorization, transactions, side effects, and open gaps are evidenced.

directory-and-architecture-review.description: Module placement, dependency direction, cohesion, coupling, and migration boundaries were reviewed.

implementation-verification.description: Unit, integration, contract, and build evidence appropriate to the feature passed.

targeted-negative-probes.description: At least one feature-specific failure was injected, rejected, repaired, and replayed successfully.

canonical-reuse-review.description: New code uses existing clients, guards, repositories, adapters, and public entrypoints instead of duplicating them.

capability-evolution-review.description: The change was explicitly evaluated for Skill update, creation, candidate status, or a reasoned no-skill result.

governance-gate.description: The real governance completion entrypoint passed and its failure behavior is covered by a current probe.

package-smoke.description: The distributable package or deployable artifact completed a clean install and smoke test.

rollback-plan.description: A concrete revert or rollback procedure exists and names irreversible boundaries.

five-by-three-blind-evaluation.description: Five independent engineering evaluators and three architects evaluated isolated scenarios before consensus review.

greenfield-real-project.description: A real greenfield project completed initialization and a representative implementation task.

brownfield-real-project.description: A structurally different brownfield project preserved existing code while completing a representative change.

business-and-architecture-scorecards.description: Independent scorecards cover business understanding, directories, architecture, code design, encapsulation, security, Skills, and usability.

cross-platform-matrix.description: Every declared operating-system and runtime combination has current evidence or is explicitly excluded from the release claim.

baseline-comparison.description: The governed run is compared with the prior release or an ungoverned control for defects, reuse, time, tokens, and intervention.

migration-and-compatibility.description: Upgrade, backward compatibility, deprecation, and data/config migration paths were exercised.

all-applicable-negative-probes.description: Every applicable acceptance-contract probe has current negative and recovery evidence.

real-client-replay.description: Every declared AI client executed its actual configured entrypoint; synthetic invocation alone is insufficient.

package-install-smoke.description: The published-shape package was installed and exercised in clean fixtures for supported environments.

rollback-rehearsal.description: Rollback was rehearsed from the release candidate and verified to preserve user-owned state.
